summary: S.J. Res. 31 is a joint resolution that uses the Congressional Review Act to disapprove and cancel an Environmental Protection Agency rule regarding the reclassification of major air pollution sources as area sources under the Clean Air Act.

affected_groups.effect: No longer required to comply with certain major source emissions standards or specific control methods when reclassifying as area sources.
affected_groups.group: Sources of persistent and bioaccumulative hazardous air pollutants

affected_groups.effect: Its rule regarding the reclassification of major sources as area sources is invalidated and given no force or effect.

key_provisions: Disapproves of the Environmental Protection Agency rule titled Review of Final Rule Reclassification of Major Sources as Area Sources Under Section 112 of the Clean Air Act.
Declares that the specified rule shall have no force or effect.
Removes the requirements for sources of persistent and bioaccumulative hazardous air pollutants to comply with certain major source emissions standards when reclassifying as area sources.
Nullifies requirements for reclassifying sources to implement specific control methods ensuring emissions do not increase beyond previous major source requirements.
missing_information: Specific details on the exact names or locations of affected facilities.
Quantitative estimates of the change in emissions resulting from the rule's nullification.
summary_detail.plain_summary: S.J. Res. 31 is a joint resolution that uses the Congressional Review Act to disapprove and cancel an Environmental Protection Agency rule regarding the reclassification of major air pollution sources as area sources under the Clean Air Act.
summary_detail.significance: The joint resolution invalidates a specific Environmental Protection Agency rule, altering the regulatory standards and control method requirements for certain air pollutant sources that reclassify from major sources to area sources.

title: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to "Review of Final Rule Reclassification of Major Sources as Area Sources Under Section 112 of the Clean Air Act".
